title: GDPR AI Semantic Log Purger: Shield Your Business from Conversational Data Leaks
body:
Are your customers leaking passwords, medical records, or credit cards into your AI chatbot without your knowledge?

Every day, hundreds of users interact with your bots neglecting their privacy. This sensitive data remains stored in plain text inside your vector databases and audit logs, turning your infrastructure into a legal time bomb. A single data protection authority inspection following an invisible leak could result in destructive fines of up to 4% of your annual turnover, destroying corporate trust.

The Trap of Traditional Regex Filters

Clean-up systems based on traditional regular expressions block rigid numerical sequences, but completely fail when analyzing semantic context. If a user writes their access credentials in a fragmented way or writes confidential information, standard rules are blind and unable to detect it. Regulatory compliance in the era of generative AI is not solved with static code, but with autonomous contextual intelligence.

Our Solution: AI Semantic Log Purger Agent

At LANZA ESTUDIO we integrate a specialized artificial intelligence agent that asynchronously audits, detects, and purges any trace of personal data in the root storage directory and production logs of your bots.

  1. Continuous Semantic Analysis: Evaluates the context of each request and response in real time without breaking the conversational flow.
  2. Surgical Anonymization: Replaces personal identifiers and confidential files with synthetic opaque tokens readable by the model but useless to attackers.
  3. Vector Cleansing: Automatically scans and sanitizes your vector database indexes to prevent the persistence of compromised information.
  4. Vulnerability Alerts: Immediately notifies your technical team through secure channels regarding exfiltration attempts or massive leaks.

The Real Impact on Corporate Compliance

  • Absolute Legal Shielding: Guarantees full compliance with GDPR and the strictest European regulations, eliminating the risk of direct financial penalties.
  • Scalable B2B Trust: Allows you to close high-volume contracts with demanding corporate clients by demonstrating secure and flawless data audits.
  • Infrastructure Efficiency: Reduces storage costs by purging redundant and useless metadata within your production cloud clusters.
